title: Stop measuring your walk by someone else’s limp. 🚫🚶‍♂️
paragraphs: Stop measuring your walk by someone else’s limp. 🚫🚶‍♂️
It’s easy to feel righteous when you compare yourself to people who are struggling or compromising. But the standard was never your neighbor, your pastor, or the person in the pew next to you.
Humans are flawed. The Word is infallible. If you want comfort, look at people. If you want transformation, look at Scripture.
📖 "Examine yourselves to see whether you are in the faith; test yourselves." — 2 Corinthians 13:5
